In Little Canada with Michigan Governor Gretchen Whitmer w/LIUNA & the Operating Engineers about expanding apprenticeships and connecting more Minnesotans to good-paying jobs.

Skills training and apprenticeships create stronger workers and a stronger economy in MN & Michigan!
I stand with the Annunciation parents, students, and dedicated Minnesotans who are speaking out at the State Capitol to demand common-sense reforms to reduce gun violence and keep our kids safe.

Spoke with the Mayor of Two Harbors. The winds are still a major issue today with the fires up north, but we hope the rain will help tomorrow. This video is an incredible example of pilots taking water from Lake Superior to fight the fires.

Video

The U.S. House took an important step by passing legislation to allow year-round E15 which had the support of every member of MN’s delegation.  I have led this bipartisan bill in the Senate for years because expanding biofuels will help lower prices at the pump, support farmers, and strengthen our energy independence.

Now the Senate needs to act.

Firefighters and emergency responders are battling dangerous wildfire conditions across northeastern Minnesota. They are doing heroic work. 

All should continue to follow local emergency guidance and avoid closed areas so crews can safely do their work.
Thank you to the Annunciation parents, students, and nearly 8,000 people who signed the petition to stand with lawmakers who are rightfully demanding action on gun violence in the Minnesota House.

BREAKING: Mifepristone will remain accessible for now, which is good news — but it’s clear women’s health care is under attack. We have to restore the protections of Roe. v Wade nationwide.


The Associated Press (@AP)

BREAKING: The Supreme Court preserves access to widely used abortion pill, mifepristone, while a lawsuit plays out. apnews.com/article/supreme-c…




— https://nitter.net/AP/status/2055040324985115060#m

Women were excluded from clinical trials until 1993. 

It took an act of Congress to include women in medical research. Since then, we’ve been fighting to bridge the gap. But, this administration is now taking us backward by cutting NIH funding.

This Women’s Health Week shows we need to keep pushing forward.

I worked with Willmar Mayor Doug Reese and local officials to deliver federal funding for an overpass to make County Road 55 in Kandiyohi County safer. Now it's getting built — and will be finished later this year.

wctrib.com/news/local/constr…

Some of our state government offices still use computers with black screens and a blinking cursor.

As governor, I will replace these decades-old systems with modern technology that delivers results — and holds government accountable to you.

Video

End this war and your tariffs Mr. President


ABC News (@ABC)

Grocery prices in the U.S. soared faster in April than any month in nearly four years, driving up the cost of everything from frankfurters to tomatoes to cupcakes, according to government data. abcnews.link/xPaGhxl




— https://nitter.net/ABC/status/2054815773592314162#m

I met with students and teachers from Annunciation Catholic School during their trip to DC.

They have gone through so much, but they continue to show the courage and strength to fight for what they believe in.

In Minnesota and Washington, we must continue to work to pass common-sense gun safety legislation.

I'm grateful to have earned the support of Minnesota Teamsters, representing over 50,000 workers across our state. From fair wages to job training, I believe in standing up for hardworking Minnesotans, and that's what I will continue to do as Governor.

This evening I was on the National Mall to honor the lives of fallen Minnesota law enforcement officers Felicia Reilly, Richard Legler, & Jesse Branch at the National Law Enforcement Officers Memorial candlelight vigil. They made the ultimate sacrifice & served with honor. 🇺🇸

Today, I voted to rein in President Trump’s war in Iran — and 3 Republicans voted with us.

We need more of them to stand up and join us to end this reckless war and work together to bring down skyrocketing costs for the American people.

In Minnesota, our legislature just advanced common-sense legislation to protect our kids from addictive features on social media.

Big tech isn’t going to step up, so our lawmakers did.

Dr. Gianrico Farrugia has led Mayo Clinic with vision and commitment — advancing world-class care, driving innovation, and expanding groundbreaking medical research.

Thank you for your leadership and lasting impact on Minnesota and beyond.

postbulletin.com/health/mayo…
Higher fuel costs are driving up grocery prices across the country. This administration’s reckless war with Iran is rippling through our economy, with families and small businesses paying the price.

Three federal judges tried to override decades of science and ban a medication the FDA has deemed safe for 25 years. The Supreme Court put that decision on hold—but the fight isn’t over. We must keep fighting to protect reproductive freedom.

Video

I’m standing with parents and advocates to push for the Kids Online Safety Act to hold platforms accountable, strengthen parental tools, and bring transparency to the algorithms shaping what our kids see.

Video
